title: Website: bring back the homepage terminal chat, on the white theme, as product orientation only
body:
Owner, 2026-10-01: the previous openagents.com (private `coder` repo, `bins/coder-serve/src/homepage.rs` + `home_ask/` + `home_knowledge.rs`) had a terminal on `/` where a visitor could chat. Add that to the current site in `crates/openagents-web`, in our white-on-near-black theme, tied into the same OpenAgents chat as the phone and desktop. It must **not** connect to the desktop app, a computer, or Coder: it answers about OpenAgents (knowledge base, product orientation), knows it's on the website, and encourages downloading the desktop app (`/install`).

Plan:
- **Surface `web`** in the chat router (`crates/openagents-chat/src/router.rs`, `crates/coder/src/router.rs`). Web instructions: we're on the openagents.com website; no Coder, no computer; point to /install.
- **Worker policy** (`crates/coder/src/router/policy.rs`): on the web only answer-family tiers (prepared answers, knowledge grounding, model), with no offers, cards, decks, or command proposals. Work, Gym, screen, wallet, and account routes become a model answer pointing to the desktop app. Refusals unchanged. Deploy the chat worker.
- **Website**: a terminal on `/` (welcome card, typed rows, composer; `help`, `install`, `docs`, `clear`). Any other line is a question posted to `POST /ask`, which sends a NIP-CJ job through `openagents_chat::basic_coder::Relay` with a per-visitor key derived on the server, and streams the reply back as SSE. Per-visitor in-flight/per-minute limits on our side; the worker's per-key and daily quotas still apply. No accounts, no attachments.
- Tests for the router surface, policy, and the `/ask` route; docs (`docs/deployment/openagents-web.md`, NIP/INVARIANTS rows as needed).

The site itself stays undeployed (openagents.com still serves from `coder`).
